_comment: HAND-COMPUTED expectations for probes/widgets/popover-scroll/Main.as (the SETTLE frame: no panel open, offsetY 0). Never regenerate these by running the probe.

_derivation.geometry: Window 320x300. Root column, padding 10, background 0x111111, one child: the viewport (280x150) at (10,10) with background 0xF5F5F5 and both bars "never". Viewport children in order: spacer 280x40 0xDDDDDD, trigger 200x34 0x2563EB, spacer 280x200 0xCCCCCC. So contentH = 40+34+200 = 274 and maxOffsetY = 274-150 = 124. The trigger sits at y = 10 + 40 = 50 -> (10,50,200,34).
points: (60,20) is 10px inside the viewport, in the first spacer 10..50 -> 0xDDDDDD.
(260,60) is in the viewport's empty right part beside the narrow trigger -> 0xF5F5F5.
(60,100) is in the second spacer, which starts at 10+40+34 = 84 -> 0xCCCCCC.
(300,10) is in the root's right padding -> 0x111111.
_derivation.not_pinned: The open panels cannot live here because expect.json describes ONE frame. probes/widgets/popover-scroll/Main.as asserts them itself: the popover's y at offset 0 (92 = trigger bottom 84 + offset 8) and at offset 40 (52 = drawn trigger bottom 44 + 8), the same two frames for a MENU anchored to the same trigger, and the pixels of both (white where the panel belongs now, the pane's own 0xCCCCCC where the stale panel used to be).
